entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling about a jersey I bought a while back. I need to start a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your order number?
Thank you. I see the order here for the Apex Pro jersey. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?
Oh, it's just a preference. It's the wrong size for me. I tried it on once and it's just way too tight. I was hoping to do an exchange or just get a refund.

I understand completely. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment... Okay, I see the delivery was 46 days ago. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window. I can definitely approve this return for you.

That's great news, I appreciate it. I'll get it sent back this week. Now, since I'm going through the hassle of shipping and I'll be placing a new order for the right size, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for my trouble?

I understand why you'd ask. While I can't provide a discount code for a standard size-related return, I can process the exchange for you right now to ensure the correct size jersey is sent out as soon as we receive your return. Would you like me to set that up?
Ah, okay. I figured it was worth a shot. No, that's alright. I think I'll just take the full refund for now and re-evaluate my size later. Can you just email me the return label?

Of course. I've just processed the return authorization. You should receive an email with the pre-paid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's all. Thanks for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
